_about: What each council's own website tells private landlords about the landlord database (Register your rental property), read on the date in 'checked'. status: deadline = mentions it and gives the 15 Dec 2026 opening or the region's deadline; mentions = mentions it without dates; act only = Renters' Rights Act but not the database; nothing = landlord pages found, neither; unreachable = could not read. Quotes checked word for word against the live page on that date ('...' joins parts of one sentence). Research: co-founder/research/west-midlands-council-notices-2026-11-07.md.

Bromsgrove.quote: All landlords must register their properties on a new national Private Rented Sector database

Cannock Chase.quote: All landlords must register themselves and the properties they rent on a new online central database

Coventry.quote: landlords letting properties in the West Midlands will be the first required to register ... with a deadline of 14 March 2027

Newcastle-under-Lyme.quote: All landlords will have to register their properties on a new national private rented sector database

Nuneaton and Bedworth.quote: From 15 December 2026, the Government is rolling out the 'Register your rental property' service ... with a deadline of 14 March 2027

Redditch.quote: All landlords must register their properties on a new national Private Rented Sector database

Sandwell.quote: required to register their let property with the national database scheme from have from 15th December 2026 and by 14th March 2027

South Staffordshire.quote: You must register each property on the new private rented sector database

Stafford.quote: All landlords must register themselves and the properties they rent on a new online central database

Stratford-on-Avon.quote: The Private Rented Sector (PRS) Database is expected to be introduced in late 2026

Walsall.quote: You must register each property on the new private rented sector database

Wyre Forest.quote: Landlords across the West Midlands will be required to register ... when it launches on 15 December 2026

East of England.note: Two councils give landlords the wrong date: Castle Point says the database is unlikely to be in place before 2028, and Babergh still says it is coming in October 2026. The service opens on 15 December 2026, and East of England landlords must register between 15 January and 14 April 2027.

Babergh.quote: Property registered on the Government property database (coming October 2026)

Bedford.quote: All landlords must register their properties on a new national private rented sector database.

Braintree.quote: In late 2026, landlords will have to register their properties on a national Private Rented Sector database.

Brentwood.quote: In late 2026, landlords will have to register their properties on a new national Private Rented Sector database.

Broadland.quote: Phase 2 – PRS Database & Ombudsman: due late 2026

Broxbourne.quote: Rollout of the new national landlord database will start in December 2026

Cambridge.quote: Landlords must register themselves and their properties from January 2027

Castle Point.quote: The introduction of a landlord database and Private Rented Sector Ombudsman will help address disputes ... however this is unlikely to be in place before 2028.

Chelmsford.quote: In late 2026, landlords will have to register their properties on a national Private Rented Sector database.

Fenland.quote: From winter 2026, Government requires landlords to register their properties under Renters' Rights Act rules

Luton.quote: landlords must register on a national database

Maldon.quote: a requirement for landlords to register with a private rented sector portal will come into force towards the end of 2026

Mid Suffolk.quote: Registration & Redress: Mandatory membership of the PRS database and Ombudsman scheme.

North Hertfordshire.quote: In the future, a database, an ombudsman, Awaab's Law, and the Decent Homes Standard will all be implemented in the private rented sector.

North Norfolk.quote: Expected late 2026: Private Rent Sector Database and Landlord Ombudsman

Norwich.quote: Phase 2 of the Renters' Rights Act rollout includes a Private Rented Sector Database.

Peterborough.quote: Further changes, including the creation of a National Landlord Database, are due to follow

South Norfolk.quote: Phase 2 – PRS Database & Ombudsman: due late 2026

Stevenage.quote: a new landlord database and property portal (being introduced in phases)

Tendring.quote: Landlords must register on the new Private Rented Sector Database and join a Landlord Ombudsman Scheme (phased in from late 2026).

Thurrock.quote: This includes a database of private landlords, a new landlord Ombudsman to help resolve disputes

Uttlesford.quote: All landlords will have to register their properties on a new national private rented sector database
